CustomField.description: Staleness threshold for CursorBatchReplayGuard. A Platform Event whose own CreatedDate is older than this is rejected without being dispatched. Blank uses the framework default of 60 minutes. Set to -1 to disable the age gate for this job, which is only appropriate for a job whose events can legitimately sit undelivered for hours.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Reject events older than this many minutes. Leave blank for the default of 60. Set to -1 to disable the age check for this job.
CustomField.label: Max Event Age (min)
